def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # line color: rows that have no fill; majority color there
    line_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for c in range(w))]

    # specials = other colors
    specials=set(cnt)-{fill,lc}
    def is_special(v): return v in specials
    srows=[r for r in line_rows if any(is_special(g[r][c]) for c in range(w))]
    line_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(h))]
    scols=[c for c in line_cols if any(is_special(g[r][c]) for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(srows)-1):

        for j in range(len(scols)-1):

            if all(is_special(v) for v in corners) and len(set(corners))==1:

            else:
